branch_map.taken_edge: Update g_91AC for a new free-list head; fallthrough otherwise writes previous->next.

call_map.arguments: (dst=b, src=NEXTBLK(b), paragraphs=NEXTBLK(b)->paras); two far pointers and unsigned 16-bit paragraph count; far caller-clean ABI (10 argument bytes). The pinned original helper copies count*16 bytes, including the moved block header and payload.

reads: Input block header *b copied to the 32-byte automatic save; b.segment captured as unsigned long.
Adjacent source block begins at segment SEG(b)+b.paras, offset zero; its +0x06 paragraph count determines helper copy size; copied header provides handle, paras, prev, next.
s_2F46 far handle-table base plus copied block.handle selects the master-pointer entry.
After restoring the saved free header, reads b.prev and b.next; on adjacency path reads successor.next and successor.paras.
writes: f_194D_0006 copies the entire adjacent block (paras paragraphs) into the hole at b.
Master table entry at s_2F46 + copied b.handle receives the moved payload far pointer at old hole address + 0x20000L (two paragraphs), preserving offset and advancing segment by two.

Restores save as a free header after the moved block; updates either prior free block next or g_91AC; if successor is contiguous, removes it and adds its paragraph count; updates successor.prev when non-null.

findings: Block byte layout used here: handle +0x00 word; paras +0x06 word; type +0x08 byte; lock +0x09 byte; next +0x0E word; prev +0x10 word; total 32 bytes (the 16-word save/copy shape).
SEG extraction and b->next/b->paras fields are 16-bit unsigned words; saved seg is unsigned long; (long)b + 0x20000L advances the far pointer by exactly two paragraphs while preserving its offset.
Adjacency expression is 16-bit unsigned subtraction; helper count is unsigned 16-bit paragraphs, not bytes.
